This '''mission''' took place in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] when [[Jahan Cross]] went undercover at the [[Imperial Research Station 61]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]. He was investigating [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Milosh Muhrlein]], who was in charge of the research facility. Cross found information in the colonel's records that indicated experimental droids and devices created at the station were the same as those being sold on the black market. When Muhrlein's attempt to bribe Cross failed, Cross and his droid [[IN-GA 44]] were attacked by Muhrlein and his two prototype [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], [[B-2A]] and [[B-2B]].

IN-GA 44 destroyed the two battle droids while Cross killed Muhrlein with a device that electrocuted the colonel.
